title: OpenESM：能量引导模型是可扩展的基础学习器
summary: 提出能量引导模型（ESM），将能量引导与token生成整合到单一架构中，先优化能量景观上的潜在状态再生成token，在三个大规模语料上预训练并在26个下游任务上评估，多数任务超越GPT，且开源模型权重与训练基础设施。
summary_en: Introduces Energy-Steered Models (ESMs) that integrate energy steering and token generation in one architecture, optimizing a latent state over an energy landscape before generating tokens. Pre-trained on three large corpora and evaluated on 26 downstream tasks, ESMs show promising scaling behavior and outperform GPTs on most tasks; weights and training infrastructure are fully open-sourced.
